channel.title: Twitter | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: What can we learn from Periscope
item.description: I have been using Periscope for a while now, and I am really enjoying it. If you don’t know it, Periscope is Twitter’s new live streaming app, that allows anyone to stream directly from one’s smartphone, and it will notify you as soon as someone you follow is live-streaming.
